evidence.quote: if not books.Books.Customers.IsEmpty || not books.Books.Drafts.IsEmpty || not books.Books.Invoices.IsEmpty || not books.Payments.IsEmpty then

ARC-REV-01.rationale: Every new domain rule sits in Tier 2. The transfer file format, the order of the refusal checks and the data-version match are in Summa.Storage.Transfer. The import guard, the GitHub refusal and the files-pack check are in Summa.Web.Engine. The only Tier 3 change in Summa.Web.Application.AccountingWire maps three kernel events to engine messages and decides nothing. The Tier 4 page app/index.html only binds the canTransferBooks flag, which the engine computes.

evidence.quote: match Transfer.export manifest books ctx.Now with

ARC-REV-02.rationale: No new effect is added below Tier 4. The time comes in through ctx.Now. The download is requested as an OfferDownload effect value, and the import goes through the existing save path, which returns a SaveBooks effect. Transfer.fs is pure: it uses Arca's Json codec and DateTimeOffset parsing, with no System.IO, System.Text.Json or clock reads. Base64 and UTF-8 encoding are pure transformations.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: Most facts reuse existing definitions: Exports.Classification, Exports.dataVersion, LocalSnapshot.encode/decode, Codec.dateText and businessToday. The Schema and Version literals are defined once. The exportedAt timestamp format, however, is written as two separate string literals, one for writing (line 75) and one for parsing (line 108). The copies agree today but have no shared definition.

evidence.quote: if n = 2m && contentsOf root <> Some counts then

ARC-REV-01.rationale: What counts as a customer, an issued invoice or a recorded payment, and the check that a file's contents match its books, are defined in Summa.Storage.Transfer (Tier 2). The preview in Summa.Web.Engine (Tier 2) asks Transfer.read and uses its Contents rather than counting again. No Tier 3 code changes. app/index.html only binds booksTransferPreview.

evidence.quote: | BooksTransferTextChanged v -> { model with BooksTransferText = v; BooksTransferPreview = transferPreview v }, []

ARC-REV-02.rationale: No new effect is introduced. The preview is computed purely from the pasted text and returns no effects. The contents counts and the version-2 read are pure.

evidence.quote: if n = 2m && contentsOf root <> Some counts then

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The contents counts have a single definition (Transfer.contents), which export, read and the engine preview all use. However, the reader restates the current version as the bare literal 2m (lines 93 and 113) instead of referencing the Version constant. The copies agree now, but bumping Version would leave the reader behind. The duplicated timestamp format literal from change set 1 also remains.
